headline: Read boiler temperatures and control its pumps
intro: Connect an eSterownik eCoal.pl boiler controller to Home Assistant with its host address and login. The integration exposes controller temperature readings as Celsius sensors and offers switches for supported heating and hot water pumps.
highlights: Configure the controller host; the integration defaults the username and password to admin
Read up to ten temperature values, including indoor, outdoor, hot water, feedwater, fuel feeder, and exhaust readings
Monitor and switch the central heating, second central heating, and domestic hot water pumps

flow.title: From controller connection to boiler controls
stages: Provide the controller host and credentials
Home Assistant checks the controller status
Read temperature sensors and control available pump switches
